name: Curcumin
aliases: Haldar, Halad, Souchet, C.I. 75300, C.I. Natural Yellow 3, CI Natural Yellow 3, Cucurmin, Curcumin I
summary: Curcumin is a bright yellow chemical produced by the plant species Curcuma longa. It is the principal curcuminoid of turmeric (Curcuma longa), a member of the ginger family, Zingiberaceae. It is sold as an herbal supplement, cosmetics ingredient, food flavoring, and food coloring.

pharmacology.text: Curcumin, which shows positive results in most drug discovery assays, is regarded as a false lead that medicinal chemists include among "pan-assay interference compounds". This attracts undue experimental attention while failing to advance as viable therapeutic or drug leads, although some derivatives of curcumin such as EF-24 have been well-studied.

uses.text: The most common applications are as an ingredient in dietary supplement, in cosmetics, as flavoring for foods, such as turmeric-flavored beverages in South and Southeast Asia, and as coloring for foods, such as curry powders, mustards, butters, and cheeses. As a food additive for orange-yellow coloring in prepared foods, its E number is E 100 in the European Union. It is also approved by the U.S. FDA to be used as a food coloring in US.

summaryZh: 薑黃素（英語：curcumin）是一種從薑黃根莖中提取得到的黃色色素，屬酚類色素，結構為二芳基庚烷。它是最主要的薑黃色素類物質，約占薑黃色素的70％，約為薑黃的3％～6％。除了薑黃素之外，這一類化合物還包括去甲氧基薑黃素、雙去甲氧基薑黃素和六氫薑黃素等。

sideEffects.en: It can cause stomach upset, nausea and diarrhoea. Rare cases of liver injury have been reported with concentrated turmeric and curcumin supplements.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成腸胃不適、噁心與腹瀉。高濃度的薑黃或薑黃素補充品曾有罕見的肝損傷報告。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成肠胃不适、恶心与腹泻。高浓度的姜黄或姜黄素补充品曾有罕见的肝损伤报告。

fact.en: Curcumin turns from yellow to red when it meets an alkali such as soap or baking soda, which is why turmeric stains can turn red when washed with soap.
fact.zh: 薑黃素遇到肥皂或小蘇打等鹼性物質時會從黃色變成紅色，所以薑黃污漬用肥皂洗時可能會變紅。
fact.zhHans: 姜黄素遇到肥皂或小苏打等碱性物质时会从黄色变成红色，所以姜黄污渍用肥皂洗时可能会变红。
